input.quote: The Licensee shall calculate the license fee payable to the Licensor for each month based on the Monthly Notional Volume bands for that pay period and shall pay the Licensor accordingly. In no event shall the amount payable by the Licensor be less than the amount recorded by the Licensee as being traded with the Licensed Technology multiplied by the applicable Fees set forth above.
input.rationale: The fee architecture is purely usage-based and contains no minimum purchase commitment: user fees are charged per US$1 million actually traded on the Platform under the Monthly Notional Volume bands (p0056–p0058, p0067), and the only "floor" in p0070 is measured by the volume the Licensee actually records as traded, not by any committed volume. There is no take-or-pay, minimum monthly/annual volume, shortfall charge, or volume cap on our usage anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "minimum", "shortfall" and the exclusivity/term provisions return nothing of that kind); the tiered rates are volume discounts, which the rule expressly does not treat as a commitment. The other recurring amounts — the $35,000 initial payment (p0051) and the $2,500/month technical support fee (p0086) — are fees for ordered services, which the preferred position permits, and the volume-based rebate in p0076 is a benefit running to us. This therefore meets the preferred position, so no redline is warranted. Noted only for context (and addressed under the term/termination rule rather than here): the 36-month Initial Period in p0049 gives the Licensee no convenience-exit, but because no minimum volume is committed, exposure is limited to actual usage plus the support fee.
